instruction: A tournament-style carved wooden chess knight: a turned circular base, a tapered neck rising to a stylized horse head with a carved mane, defined jaw, and undercuts around the muzzle. Warm wood grain, recognizable as a classic Staunton knight.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a carved wooden chess knight. A tournament-style carved wooden chess knight: a turned circular base, a tapered neck rising to a stylized horse head with a carved mane, defined jaw, and undercuts around the muzzle. Warm wood grain, recognizable as a classic Staunton knight. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
